title: Ashen Heron intrusion at a freight operator
text: Ashen Heron gained access to a Fenwick Freight file server through CVE-2099-41077 in the Corvane VPN gateway. The actor deployed QuillRAT, which beaconed to hxxps://relay[.]heron-cdn[.]example[.]net/api/v2 and 198.51.100[.]23. The operators ran Mimikatz to dump credentials and moved laterally with PsExec. QuillRAT sample SHA-256: 08c79defb19de2d48f51540dcc1e86a9608fb1ee0948a62092c4cae2ab785f30.

title: LX-0417 returns with a new loader
text: LX-0417 returned in March with a new build of the implant some vendors call QRAT. A Mothvine Loader stage fetched the payload from update-check[.]example[.]org. The group used AdFind to enumerate the domain and copied files to cloud storage with rclone. Loader MD5: 62141b06f13383b7b6781307c03ee953. Payload SHA-1: 4dbd6e21f1f7a6aea42963434b588af9f8dd67fa.

title: Partner advisory: Grey Lantern at a water utility
text: A partner advisory attributes the intrusion at Hollin Water to Grey Lantern. The operators dropped Mothvine through a phishing attachment and ran PowerShell scripts that downloaded a second stage from 203.0.113[.]77.

title: New group deploys SaltGlass ransomware
text: A newly observed group we track as Velvet Ostrich deployed SaltGlass ransomware at a regional clinic network. Before encryption the operators deleted shadow copies with vssadmin. Ransom notes pointed victims to hxxp://saltglass-pay[.]example[.]com/portal. Encryptor SHA-256: 9c375549022333f0b203431655306e4131a2c0096f5c4d4372e63c04381165f1.

title: Copper Moth tunnels out through Chisel
text: Copper Moth operators tunnelled RDP traffic out of the network through Chisel and kept a QuillRAT backdoor on two hosts. Initial access came through CVE-2099-50213 in an unpatched Corvane VPN gateway.

title: Ashen Heron phishing infrastructure
text: Ashen Heron hosted its phishing pages at https://login-portal.example.com/owa/ and served the QuillRAT dropper from http://192.0.2.44/q.ps1. The dropper MD5 in the partner feed was 0f953ecb6bdc95f1aaddb8a98b27db0, one character short.

title: Mothvine update from Copper Moth
text: Copper Moth updated Mothvine to build 4.2.0.118 and now signs it with a stolen certificate. Defenders should look for the scheduled task SvcHealth and the file mothvine_cfg.dat. The loader contacts cdn-sync[.]example[.]org on port 8443.

title: Quarterly patch summary
text: The IT team applied the March updates to 412 laptops and retired two legacy file servers. No incidents were attributed to any threat group this quarter, and the next patch window opens on April 14.
